description: Pull only the part you need out of a big JSON response, without loading it into your context: give a URL (or inline JSON, up to 1.5 MB) and a path, and get just the matches. Supports $.a.b, [0], [-1], [0:5], [*], ..key (any depth) and filters like [?(@.price>10)] or [?(@.name=~"usd")], plus fields= to keep only some keys and limit=. Returns bytes in vs out and the tokens saved. $0.003. Costs $0.003 USDC per call (x402).

fields.description: comma-separated keys to keep on each match

name: json_query
title: json query
